# SIGHTINGS MEGATHREAD: POST WHAT YOU SAW [color=#8A7A62]Pinned. Time, place, light, distance. Then what it did.[/color]
### #1 fence_walker (OP) // 83.04.03 0140, south fence, between the second floodlight and the drainage outflow. I walk the fence on nights for maintenance, checking the posts. Good light from the floods, maybe thirty metres away.
It came along the outside of the fence, low, the way a dog runs when it has seen a rabbit. Red brown. It shone when it went under the light, like it was wet, or like it was a beetle. It did not run like a dog. Its back did not go up and down. It just slid along, fast, and the tail went out behind it straight as a pole.
Then it went over the fence. Two metres of mesh. It did not climb. It jumped it, from a run, and landed on the inside and kept going toward the pump house, and I stood there with a torch and a wrench and did not do one single useful thing.
### #2 hydro_lettuce // 83.04.04 Hydroponics, late shift, 0300 or so. Not a clear look. Something went past the long window at the end of the grow room, outside, and the motion lamps came on along the whole wall one after another, like dominoes, faster than I could turn my head. Whatever it was, it went the length of the building in about two seconds.
### #3 tarp_theory // 83.04.04 Every colony gets one of these. A hauler drops off a crew, the crew has a dog, the dog runs off into the scrub and goes feral and loses its fur from mange. Bald dogs look red under sodium lights. I am not saying you did not see something, I am saying you saw a dog.
### #4 fence_walker (OP) // 83.04.05 I know what a dog looks like. Dogs have eyes. I had my torch on its face for half a second as it turned at the pump house and there was nothing on the front of its head. Just a long smooth shape, like a helmet. And teeth. A lot of teeth, all at the front, wet.
### #5 small_and_brave // 83.04.09 my mum says i shouldnt post here but i saw it from my window in the habs. it was sitting on the roof of the tool shed like a cat does. it didnt have eyes but it was looking at our window. i know it was looking. then it hissed like the kettle and jumped off and was gone. i told security and they said it was a dog and gave me a sticker
### #6 redwatch_mod (mod) // 83.04.09 Thank you for posting. You did the right thing telling security, even if they gave you a sticker. Please keep your window shut at night, and tell your mum the board said so.
### #7 pump_house_pete // 83.04.12 Not a sighting, a mark. Pump house, outer mesh, near the base. There is a hole in the mesh about the size of my fist. Not cut. The wire ends are melted and there is a brown crust around them. The plating under it has little pits in it, like it was splashed with battery acid. Two of the pits go right through.
Security came, looked at it, and told me a cleaning chemical must have leaked. We do not keep cleaning chemicals at the pump house.
### #8 old_rancher // 83.04.15 Tracks in the mud by the south outflow, this morning. I have been reading tracks for forty years on three worlds. These were not paws. Long, narrow, like a hand pressed down with the fingers spread, and each finger ended in a point that went in deep. Longer than my boot. Set far apart. Whatever made them was not walking. It was running, and the gap between each set was further than I can jump.
Then a long drag mark, very straight. That would be the tail.
### #9 tarp_theory // 83.04.16 Okay. Okay. I will admit dogs do not melt pump houses.
### #10 fence_walker (OP) // 83.04.27 Seen it again, or one like it. Same fence, same hour. This time I was not alone. A security officer was with me. He put his rifle up and I grabbed his arm, because it was right next to the generator fuel line and I thought of the pump house mesh.
He did not fire. It looked at us. It does not have eyes and it looked at us. Then it went down into the south drainage outflow, head first, like water going down a drain.
The officer told me not to put it in my report. I am putting it here instead.
